name: Malakhi Dudley
strengths: Dudley brings true 6-6 / 320 mass and length to set a firm edge in the run game.
Dudley mirrors in pass protection with a wide base and keeps rushers off his chest with reach.
Dudley finishes blocks through the whistle and does not look soft once he latches.
weaknesses: Dudley still needs to refine lateral quickness versus elite speed rushers on the edge.
comparison: Dudley comps to Penei Sewell — 6-5 / 6-6 tackle mold with mass, length, and finishing mentality who can anchor an SEC edge.
projection: Dudley projects as a Year 2 SEC starter at OT (scout / rotation Year 1). Ceiling: multi-year All-SEC tackle — the mass-and-length anchor who can lock down an edge.
schemeFit: Dudley fits as a boundary OT who can set the edge in the run game and grow into every-down pass protection.
insiderNotes: Dudley is a 6-6 / 320 Heritage (Ga.) tackle with true mass, length, and a finishing mentality in the run game. Pass sets show a wide base and reach. Wins with size and anchor traits — a cornerstone OT mold for Florida’s line.
staffNotes: Vault film desk drafted 2026-08-06 from On3/Hudl + board bio. Comp size-matched within ~1–2" — not a Florida-alum default.

angle: Lead with 6-6 / 320 mass + edge set; Florida OT chase.
